description: This file defines a utility class 'StringUtils' providing various static methods for string manipulation, exception handling, random string generation, and encoding.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for string operations such as formatting, comparison, encoding, and random string generation.

methods.name: getExceptionMessage
methods.description: Returns the message of a Throwable or its class name if the message is null.

methods.name: exceptionTrace
methods.description: Returns a String containing the complete stack trace of a Throwable.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of a string, or 0 if null.

methods.name: camelCase
methods.description: Converts underscore or space-separated strings into CamelCase.

methods.name: javaIdentifier
methods.description: Converts underscore-separated string into Java-style identifier (camel case).

methods.name: padStringBuffer
methods.description: Pads a StringBuffer with a specified character until it reaches a total size.

methods.name: makeValidIdentifier
methods.description: Replaces spaces, dashes, slashes, backslashes, and commas with underscores for filename or identifier safety.

methods.name: substitute
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a search string within a StringBuffer with a replacement string.

methods.name: escapeQuotes
methods.description: Escapes double-quote characters in a string by prefixing with a backslash.

methods.name: escapeTicks
methods.description: Escapes single-quote characters in a string.

methods.name: trimQuotes
methods.description: Removes surrounding single or double quotes from a string.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a string is null or empty after trimming.

methods.name: emptyIfNull
methods.description: Returns an empty string if input is null; otherwise, returns the string.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two strings for equality, considering nulls as equal.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two strings for equality with case-insensitivity option.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Performs lexicographical comparison of two strings, considering nulls.

methods.name: generateRandomString
methods.description: Generates a secure random alphanumeric string of specified length.

methods.name: generateRandomNumberString
methods.description: Generates a secure random numeric string of specified length.

methods.name: generateSecureRandomAlphaNumString
methods.description: Generates a secure random alphanumeric string using SHA-256 digest.

methods.name: convertToAlphaNumeric
methods.description: Converts a byte into a character within 0-9, A-Z, a-z.

methods.name: lpad
methods.description: Left-pads a string to a specified length with a given character.
